title: Airliner wingspans: 737 to 747
subject: vehicles
basis: Tip-to-tip wingspan in plan view. 737, 757 and 767 use baseline wings without optional retrofit winglets; approximate source-rounded values. Sourced outlines are simplified, not engineering drawings.
